synopsis_en: A romantic drama adapting Jane Austen's 1811 novel 'Sense and Sensibility,' relocated to modern-day South India. Directed by Rajiv Menon and featuring music by A. R. Rahman, the duo behind 'Mridangam: The Beat of Passion,' this film was released in 2000. In a prestigious family in Tamil Nadu, South India, the reserved and intelligent elder sister Sowmya works as a school principal, while her free-spirited younger sister Meenakshi, who loves poetry and South Indian classical music, lives in a dreamy haze. After their grandfather's death, the family estate passes to a distant relative, forcing the mother and daughters to start a new life in the bustling city of Chennai. Meenakshi meets a young businessman who loves poetry and a former soldier who lost a leg in war and now grows flowers, while Sowmya encounters a man aspiring to be a film director. Through their respective loves and careers, the sisters gradually discover their own paths in life. Tabu, known for 'The Namesake' and 'Life of Pi,' plays Sowmya; Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, known for 'Robot,' plays Meenakshi; and Ajith Kumar, Mammootty, and Abbas co-star.

An emotional musical film, with numerous hit songs coloring the love and bond between the couple played by James Stewart and June Allyson!

synopsis: 草創期のTVアニメは受注が不安定だったことから、劇場用を安定受注するため企画された中篇映画「B作」の1作目（従来の長篇は「A作」と呼ばれる）。石ノ森章太郎（当時・石森章太郎）の人気SFマンガを原作にとり、作画監督に「レインボー戦隊ロビン」の木村圭市郎ほかTVアニメのスタッフを起用、TVの省力化技法も使われた。仲間の1人を子供の姿にするなど原作からの変更もあるが、戦いは陸、海、空へと展開して娯楽性は高く、スコープサイズを意識した画作りも見られる。
tmdb_overview_jp: 世界各地の都市を破壊する巨大怪獣を倒すべく、平和な日常を捨てて、再び集結したサイボーグ戦士たち。その旅の途中で009は記憶喪失の少女・ヘレナと出会うが、それさえも「黒い幽霊団（ブラック・ゴースト）」の罠だった。怪獣を追い詰めたその先に待っていたのは009の前に立ちはだかるヘレナ。なんと彼女は「黒い幽霊団（ブラック・ゴースト）」のスパイ、サイボーグ0010だったのだ！ ヘレナと対決するものの、彼女にトドメを刺すことができない009。やがて009に命を救われたことで心が動いたヘレナの助力によって、サイボーグ戦士たちは敵基地の爆破に成功し、ついには「黒い幽霊団（ブラック・ゴースト）」の野望を打ち砕いたのであった。

synopsis_en: During the early days of TV anime, orders were unstable, so to secure steady theatrical commissions, a medium-length film series called "B Works" was planned (conventional feature-length films were called "A Works"). Based on Shotaro Ishinomori's popular sci-fi manga, the film employed TV anime staff such as Keiichiro Kimura, the animation director of "Rainbow Sentai Robin," and utilized TV production efficiency techniques. While there were changes from the original manga, such as turning one of the characters into a child, the battles unfold across land, sea, and air, offering high entertainment value, and the composition shows awareness of widescreen framing.

tmdb_overview_jp: ある日、世界各国の主要都市を謎の巨大ロボット群が襲撃する。それは、ミケーネ帝国の暗黒大将軍によって送り込まれた戦闘獣軍団の先発隊だった。  ニューヨーク、ロンドン、パリ、モスクワを壊滅させたその魔の手は、日本にも伸びていた。東京への襲撃に際し、兜甲児はマジンガーZで出動するが、新たな敵・戦闘獣の攻撃力は機械獣を凌駕しており、大苦戦を強いられる。何とか敵を退けて首都の壊滅は食い止めたものの、マジンガーZが大ダメージを受けたうえに光子力研究所も襲撃されてダイアナンAは大破し、兜シローが生死をさまよう重傷を負ってしまう。シローへの大量輸血による最悪の体調の甲児と、修理できないまま再出撃したマジンガーZの前に、獣魔将軍率いる戦闘獣軍団が迫る。  死を覚悟した甲児の必死の防戦もむなしく、たちまち満身創痍と化したマジンガーZの窮地に、新たなる勇者グレートマジンガーが颯爽と現れる。

synopsis: インドに暮らすムスリム女性たちの100日以上にわたる平和的な抵抗運動を追ったドキュメンタリー。 2019年12月、インドのモディ政権はイスラム教徒を意図的に排除する市民権改正法を制定し、イスラム教徒の間では市民権を剥奪される危機感が高まった。法案に対する批判の声が高まるなか、反対運動の拠点であるジャミア・ミリア・イスラミア大学構内に警察が突入し、200人もの負傷者と多数の逮捕者を出した。この暴力的な対応と差別的な法案への抗議として、ニューデリー南部のイスラム教徒居住区シャヒーン・バーグで大規模な座り込みが始まる。その中心にいたのはムスリムの女性たちで、政府による宗教差別やデモ鎮圧は憲法違反だと主張し、日々の暮らしを営みながら100日以上にわたり幹線道路を封鎖した。この非暴力の運動は多くの人々の共感を呼び、世代や文化、宗教を越えてインド全土に広まった。しかしデリー議会選挙をきっかけに状況は緊迫し、警察による強制排除が起こる。 ムスリム女性のノウシーン・ハーンが監督を務め、政治的にも社会的にも透明化されてきたムスリム女性たちによる歴史的抵抗運動の軌跡に、自らの解放と変革の物語を重ねながら描き出す。山形国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭2023にて市民賞（観客賞）を受賞（映画祭上映時タイトル「我が理想の国」）。
tmdb_overview_en: Protests rage against the Indian Citizenship Amendment Act (CAA), which persecutes Muslims. The director listens to the voices of the protesters and observes her own identity as a Muslim woman.
synopsis_en: A documentary following over 100 days of peaceful resistance by Muslim women living in India. In December 2019, India's Modi government enacted the Citizenship Amendment Act, which deliberately excludes Muslims, heightening fears among Muslims of losing their citizenship. As criticism of the bill grew, police stormed the campus of Jamia Millia Islamia University, a protest hub, injuring 200 people and making numerous arrests. In protest against this violent response and the discriminatory law, a massive sit-in began in Shaheen Bagh, a Muslim neighborhood in South Delhi. At its center were Muslim women who, arguing that the government's religious discrimination and crackdown on protests were unconstitutional, blocked a major highway for over 100 days while continuing their daily lives. This nonviolent movement resonated with many, spreading across India beyond generations, cultures, and religions. However, tensions escalated around the Delhi legislative elections, leading to a forced police eviction. Directed by Muslim woman Nousheen Khan, the film traces the historical resistance movement by Muslim women, who have been politically and socially rendered invisible, while overlaying her own story of liberation and transformation. It won the Audience Award at the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2023 (screened under the title 'My Ideal Country').

tmdb_overview_jp: 1960年代神戸—日本で生まれたベルギー人の小さな女の子アメリ。彼女の成長を描く物語。外交官の家庭に生まれ、2歳半までは無反応状態だったアメリ。その後、子ども時代に突入した彼女は自らを「神」だと信じ、魔法のような世界を生きている。家政婦のニシオさんや家族との日々の生活は、彼女にとって冒険であり、新たな発見の連続。少しずつ変化していくアメリ。しかし、3歳の誕生日に人生を変える出来事が起こり、彼女の世界は大きく変わっていく…。誰もが子供時代に夢見た世界を描く感動のアニメーション作品
tmdb_overview_en: The world is a perplexing, peaceful mystery to Amélie until a miraculous encounter with chocolate ignites her wild sense of curiosity. As she develops a deep attachment to her family's housekeeper, Nishio-san, Amélie discovers the wonders of nature as well as the emotional truths hidden beneath the surface of her family's idyllic life as foreigners in post-war Japan.
movie_title_original: Amélie et la métaphysique des tubes
movie_title_en: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
synopsis_en: An animated film set in 1960s Kobe, depicting the growth of Amélie, a Belgian girl born in Japan. Based on the autobiographical novel "Tube Metaphysics" by Belgian writer Amélie Nothomb, it portrays a world rich in emotion, seen through the eyes of the two-year-old protagonist Amélie, woven with life, color, and her witty words. In 1960s Kobe, Amélie, a Belgian girl born into a diplomat's family, is unresponsive until age two and a half, but then enters an invincible childhood, believing herself to be a god and living in a magical world. Her days with her beloved housekeeper Nishio and her family are adventures full of new discoveries. One day, she learns the kanji for "rain," which suits her perfectly. Then, on her third birthday, an event occurs that changes everything. Directed by Myriam Ballard and Liang-Cho Han, who worked on "Long Way North," with music by Japanese composer Mari Fukuhara. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Annecy International Animated Film Festival and was nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

country: インド 原題または英題：Kandukondain Kandukondain
synopsis: イギリスの女性作家ジェーン・オースティンが1811年に発表した小説「分別と多感」を、舞台を現代の南インドに移して映画化した恋愛ドラマ。「響け！情熱のムリダンガム」の監督ラージーブ・メーナンと音楽のA・R・ラフマーンのコンビが2000年に手がけた。 南インド・タミルナードゥ州の由緒ある名家。慎ましく聡明な姉ソウミャは学校の校長を務め、詩と南インド古典音楽を愛する奔放な妹ミーナクシは夢見るように日々を過ごしていた。しかし祖父の死をきっかけに屋敷は遠縁の手に渡り、母と娘たちは大都会チェンナイで新たな生活を始めることになる。妹の前には詩を愛する若き実業家と、内戦で片足を失い花を育てて生きる元軍人が現れ、姉の前には映画監督を志す男が現れる。それぞれの恋と仕事のなかで、姉妹は自分の人生を一つずつ見つけていく。 姉ソウミャを「その名にちなんで」「ライフ・オブ・パイ　トラと漂流した227日」で知られるタブー、妹ミーナクシを「ロボット」のアイシュワリヤー・ラーイ・バッチャンが演じ、アジット・クマール、マンムーティ、アッバースが共演。
tmdb_overview_en: Two young women with differing views on love find themselves with three suitors in this modern take on Jane Austen's 'Sense and Sensibility' set in Tamil Nadu.
synopsis_en: A romantic drama adapting Jane Austen's 1811 novel 'Sense and Sensibility,' relocated to modern-day South India. Directed by Rajiv Menon and featuring music by A. R. Rahman, the duo behind 'Mridangam: The Beat of Passion,' this film was released in 2000. In a prestigious family in Tamil Nadu, South India, the reserved and intelligent elder sister Sowmya works as a school principal, while her free-spirited younger sister Meenakshi, who loves poetry and South Indian classical music, lives in a dreamy haze. After their grandfather's death, the family estate passes to a distant relative, forcing the mother and daughters to start a new life in the bustling city of Chennai. Meenakshi meets a young businessman who loves poetry and a former soldier who lost a leg in war and now grows flowers, while Sowmya encounters a man aspiring to be a film director. Through their respective loves and careers, the sisters gradually discover their own paths in life. Tabu, known for 'The Namesake' and 'Life of Pi,' plays Sowmya; Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, known for 'Robot,' plays Meenakshi; and Ajith Kumar, Mammootty, and Abbas co-star.

tmdb_overview_jp: 若きトロンボーン奏者、グレン・ミラーは常に新しいサウンドを目指していた。名門楽団に参加したものの、編曲に専念するために退団。彼の音楽に転機をもたらしたのは最愛なる妻ヘレンだった。彼女の助言で自分の楽団を結成し、やがて空前の人気と名声を得る。しかし第二次世界大戦が始まると空軍に志願入隊。1944年暮れ、グレン・ミラーを乗せた飛行機は英仏海峡で消息を絶つのだった・・・。 ジェームス・スチュアート、ジューン・アリスン演じる夫婦の愛と絆を数々のヒットナンバーが彩る、感動の音楽映画！
tmdb_overview_en: A vibrant tribute to one of America's legendary bandleaders, charting Glenn Miller's rise from obscurity and poverty to fame and wealth in the early 1940s.
synopsis_en: Young trombonist Glenn Miller was always in search of a new sound. He joined a prestigious orchestra but left to focus on arranging. The turning point in his music came from his beloved wife Helen. Following her advice, he formed his own band and eventually achieved unprecedented popularity and fame. However, when World War II began, he volunteered for the Air Force. In late 1944, the plane carrying Glenn Miller disappeared over the English Channel... An emotional musical film, with numerous hit songs coloring the love and bond between the couple played by James Stewart and June Allyson!

synopsis: 最愛の娘と平凡ながらも冴えない日々を過ごす元革命家のボブ。突然､娘がさらわれ､生活が一変する｡異常な執着心でボブを追い詰める変態軍人“ロックジョー”。次から次へと襲いかかる刺客たちとの死闘の中､テンパリながらもボブに革命家時代の闘争心がよみがえっていく。逃げなければ､生き延びられない｡だが､娘を救わなければ､父ではいられない…！！ボブのピンチに現れる“センセイ”の手を借りて､元革命家として逃げ続けた生活を捨て､戦いに身を投じたボブと娘の運命の先にあるのは､絶望か､希望か､それとも——。

synopsis: かいせつ 大阪の通天閣を望む広いボロ屋敷には風変りな間借り人たちがいた…。川島との名コンビのフランキーが、代筆やこんにゃく製造などに精を出すなんでも屋を飄々と演じ、浪花、小沢ら個性的な脇役陣もクセになる傑作群像喜劇。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_en: When Yumiko Tsuyama, a potter by profession, comes inquiring about a room for rent in an old mansion overlooking Osaka, she finds a bizarre collection of characters already living there. The unlikely leader of this menagerie is Yoda Goro, who speaks four languages fluently, is an expert in cabbage rolls, and has written  how-to books encompassing every aspect of human existence.
synopsis_en: In a large rundown house overlooking the Tsutenkaku Tower in Osaka, a group of eccentric lodgers live... Frankie, in his famous partnership with Kawashima, plays a laid-back jack-of-all-trades who works as a ghostwriter and konnyaku maker. With unique supporting actors like Naniwa and Ozawa, this is a brilliant ensemble comedy that leaves a lasting impression.

synopsis: かいせつ フランキー、森繁、伴淳の主演で全24作も製作された「駅前シリーズ」の第15作。空前の漫画ブームに乗り、フランキーが漫画家に扮した本作は、劇中で「オバケのQ太郎」「おそ松くん」も登場する伝説の異色作となっている。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー

synopsis_en: The 15th installment of the 'Ekimaé Series,' which produced 24 films starring Frankie, Morishige, and Bando. Riding the unprecedented manga boom, this film features Frankie as a manga artist and is a legendary oddity, with appearances by 'Obake no Q-taro' and 'Osomatsu-kun' within the story.

synopsis: かいせつ 元戦災孤児の男は、自分を拾ってくれた娼婦の忘れ形見の少年と暮らしていた…。戦後25年を過ぎても焼け跡と闇市を心に刻み続ける男が織りなす人情喜劇。フランキーは、チンドン屋とホストクラブで懸命に働く男を切なく好演。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: A former war orphan lives with the child of the prostitute who took him in... A heartwarming comedy woven by a man who, even 25 years after the war, still carries the scars of burnt ruins and black markets in his heart. Frankie gives a poignant performance as a man working hard as a street performer and at a host club.

synopsis: かいせつ 念願の新居に引っ越した結婚目前の工場勤めの二人が、遠縁の四人の子供を押しつけられて…。庶民のささやかな幸せをみつめた名優・宇野の監督第三作。フランキーは本作と『幕末太陽傳』でブルーリボン主演男優賞を受賞。
program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
synopsis_en: A couple working at a factory, on the verge of marriage and moving into their long-awaited new home, are saddled with four distant relatives' children... The third directorial work by the renowned actor Uno, who captures the modest happiness of ordinary people. Frankie won the Blue Ribbon Award for Best Actor for this film and 'The Sun of the Meiji Restoration'.

synopsis_en: A documentary following over 100 days of peaceful resistance by Muslim women living in India. In December 2019, India's Modi government enacted the Citizenship Amendment Act, which deliberately excludes Muslims, heightening fears among Muslims of losing their citizenship. As criticism of the bill grew, police stormed the campus of Jamia Millia Islamia University, a protest hub, injuring 200 people and making numerous arrests. In protest against this violent response and the discriminatory law, a massive sit-in began in Shaheen Bagh, a Muslim neighborhood in South Delhi. At its center were Muslim women who, arguing that the government's religious discrimination and crackdown on protests were unconstitutional, blocked a major highway for over 100 days while continuing their daily lives. This nonviolent movement resonated with many, spreading across India beyond generations, cultures, and religions. However, tensions escalated around the Delhi legislative elections, leading to a forced police eviction. Directed by Muslim woman Nousheen Khan, the film traces the historical resistance movement by Muslim women, who have been politically and socially rendered invisible, while overlaying her own story of liberation and transformation. It won the Audience Award at the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2023 (screened under the title 'My Ideal Country').

movie_title_en: Little Amélie or the Character of Rain
synopsis_en: An animated film set in 1960s Kobe, depicting the growth of Amélie, a Belgian girl born in Japan. Based on the autobiographical novel "Tube Metaphysics" by Belgian writer Amélie Nothomb, it portrays a world rich in emotion, seen through the eyes of the two-year-old protagonist Amélie, woven with life, color, and her witty words. In 1960s Kobe, Amélie, a Belgian girl born into a diplomat's family, is unresponsive until age two and a half, but then enters an invincible childhood, believing herself to be a god and living in a magical world. Her days with her beloved housekeeper Nishio and her family are adventures full of new discoveries. One day, she learns the kanji for "rain," which suits her perfectly. Then, on her third birthday, an event occurs that changes everything. Directed by Myriam Ballard and Liang-Cho Han, who worked on "Long Way North," with music by Japanese composer Mari Fukuhara. It won the Audience Award at the 2025 Annecy International Animated Film Festival and was nominated for Best Animated Feature at the 98th Academy Awards.

synopsis: イギリスの女性作家ジェーン・オースティンが1811年に発表した小説「分別と多感」を、舞台を現代の南インドに移して映画化した恋愛ドラマ。「響け！情熱のムリダンガム」の監督ラージーブ・メーナンと音楽のA・R・ラフマーンのコンビが2000年に手がけた。 南インド・タミルナードゥ州の由緒ある名家。慎ましく聡明な姉ソウミャは学校の校長を務め、詩と南インド古典音楽を愛する奔放な妹ミーナクシは夢見るように日々を過ごしていた。しかし祖父の死をきっかけに屋敷は遠縁の手に渡り、母と娘たちは大都会チェンナイで新たな生活を始めることになる。妹の前には詩を愛する若き実業家と、内戦で片足を失い花を育てて生きる元軍人が現れ、姉の前には映画監督を志す男が現れる。それぞれの恋と仕事のなかで、姉妹は自分の人生を一つずつ見つけていく。 姉ソウミャを「その名にちなんで」「ライフ・オブ・パイ　トラと漂流した227日」で知られるタブー、妹ミーナクシを「ロボット」のアイシュワリヤー・ラーイ・バッチャンが演じ、アジット・クマール、マンムーティ、アッバースが共演。
tmdb_overview_en: Two young women with differing views on love find themselves with three suitors in this modern take on Jane Austen's 'Sense and Sensibility' set in Tamil Nadu.
synopsis_en: A romantic drama adapting Jane Austen's 1811 novel 'Sense and Sensibility,' relocated to modern-day South India. Directed by Rajiv Menon and featuring music by A. R. Rahman, the duo behind 'Mridangam: The Beat of Passion,' this film was released in 2000. In a prestigious family in Tamil Nadu, South India, the reserved and intelligent elder sister Sowmya works as a school principal, while her free-spirited younger sister Meenakshi, who loves poetry and South Indian classical music, lives in a dreamy haze. After their grandfather's death, the family estate passes to a distant relative, forcing the mother and daughters to start a new life in the bustling city of Chennai. Meenakshi meets a young businessman who loves poetry and a former soldier who lost a leg in war and now grows flowers, while Sowmya encounters a man aspiring to be a film director. Through their respective loves and careers, the sisters gradually discover their own paths in life. Tabu, known for 'The Namesake' and 'Life of Pi,' plays Sowmya; Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, known for 'Robot,' plays Meenakshi; and Ajith Kumar, Mammootty, and Abbas co-star.

tmdb_overview_jp: 幕末の混沌とした時代、にぎわいを見せていた品川宿の遊郭旅籠の相模屋にひとりの町人・佐平次が訪れる。女郎のおそめを気に入り豪遊するが、実は佐平次は一文無しだった。その翌朝、佐平次は金がないことを若い衆に打ち明けるが、口八丁でその場に居座ってしまう。そして金を返済するためと相模屋で番頭まがいの仕事を始めた佐平次は、下働きから女郎衆、遊郭に出入りする人々のトラブルを持ち前の度胸と機転で解決してみせ、さらにお礼の金をしっかりためこんでいた。また、相模屋に逗留し攘夷の計画を練る長州藩士の高杉晋作、久坂玄瑞らとも交友を深め、いつしか佐平次は遊郭内で一目置かれる存在になっていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Saheji, a man-about-town, gets stuck at a high-class brothel when he can’t pay the bill. He makes the best of his situation by performing various tasks amidst the tumult of the end of the shogunate—but always by making sure to get a “commission” for his troubles.

program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
tmdb_overview_jp: 幕末の混沌とした時代、にぎわいを見せていた品川宿の遊郭旅籠の相模屋にひとりの町人・佐平次が訪れる。女郎のおそめを気に入り豪遊するが、実は佐平次は一文無しだった。その翌朝、佐平次は金がないことを若い衆に打ち明けるが、口八丁でその場に居座ってしまう。そして金を返済するためと相模屋で番頭まがいの仕事を始めた佐平次は、下働きから女郎衆、遊郭に出入りする人々のトラブルを持ち前の度胸と機転で解決してみせ、さらにお礼の金をしっかりためこんでいた。また、相模屋に逗留し攘夷の計画を練る長州藩士の高杉晋作、久坂玄瑞らとも交友を深め、いつしか佐平次は遊郭内で一目置かれる存在になっていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Saheji, a man-about-town, gets stuck at a high-class brothel when he can’t pay the bill. He makes the best of his situation by performing various tasks amidst the tumult of the end of the shogunate—but always by making sure to get a “commission” for his troubles.

program_title: 没後30年・フランキー堺 ――映画に愛された天才エンターテイナー
